context.en: The competition that launched Hua Chenyu's career. His original audition piece "无字歌" (Wordless Song) and his genre-hopping rearrangements — from Lady Gaga's "Poker Face" to Cui Jian's "假行僧" — made him the season's most talked-about contestant and ultimately the champion. Notable collab performances include "小星星 The Star" with 尚雯婕 and "忘忧草" with 欧豪 at the finals.

context.en: Hua Chenyu returned to the 《歌手》 stage in 2020 for the season titled 当打之年 ("Year of the Hit") and won the title of 歌王 (King of Singers). This run introduced several songs from his then-forthcoming album 新世界 NEW WORLD — including "斗牛", "神树", "降临", and the eventual title track — alongside the debut of "好想爱这个世界啊", which became one of the biggest Chinese singles of the year.

context.en: Hua Chenyu's contributions to film and television — main themes, insert songs, and promotional tracks. Several were composed by him personally, including the Wu Kong anthem "齐天" (2017, for the film 悟空传) and the Doupo Cangqiong theme "寒鸦少年" (2018). The range here moves from his earliest promotional single "趁你还年轻" (2013, for 等风来) through to major studio collaborations like "Here We Are" (2016, for 使徒行者).

context.en: Hua Chenyu's collaborations with major Chinese game publishers. The bulk of these are theme songs for Tencent's battle royale hit 《和平精英》 (Peacekeeper Elite), including the annual anniversary and esports anthems — "永不熄灭的火焰" for the 5th anniversary and "千万次奔向" for the 7th. Earlier game work includes "智商二五零," the hero theme for 鲁班七号 in 王者荣耀 (2017), and "代号魂斗罗" for the 魂斗罗 reboot.
